expected: Measured peak RAM/VRAM/disk, startup and failures; conservative reproducible fit.
limitations: Fit relies on a page file: the engine commits about twice its resident memory; the tested host has 47 GiB RAM and a 31 GB page file.
Peaks are per-process lifetime maxima of the serving tree alive at the end; earlier server generations (G16/G20 restarts) are not included.
observed: Engine lifetime peaks after the whole qualification and evaluation: working set 30.53 GB, private commit 63.35 GB; GPU memory 30,742-30,838 MiB of 32,607 in every sampled gate run; system RAM available while serving never below 8.5 GB (sampled every 2 s); commit headroom 7.9 GB (G10). Integration root 73.7 GB including 4.7 GB of qualification/evaluation workspaces (install alone 69.0 GB). Start to verified readiness 14.5-15.3 s on restarts, 18.6 s for the root's first start. Across 7 server logs and 521 completed requests: no watchdog stop, no OOM or CUDA error, no traceback; both engine deaths were the deliberate G15 kills, and the mid-generation one was logged with its exit code and last engine line (Strata#215 fixed).
